name: audit2e assert deepEqual is loose and AssertionError default message
source: import * as assert from "node:assert"; function main(): void { assert.deepEqual({ a: 1 }, { a: "1" }); assert.deepEqual([1, 2], ["1", 2]); assert.deepEqual(NaN, NaN); console.log("loose-ok"); try { assert.deepEqual([1, 2], [1, 2, 3]); } catch (e: any) { console.log(e.operator, e.message); } try { assert.notDeepEqual({ a: 1 }, { a: "1" }); } catch (e: any) { console.log(e.operator); } try { assert.deepStrictEqual({ a: 1 }, { a: "1" }); } catch (e: any) { console.log("strict-throws"); } console.log(new assert.AssertionError({ actual: 1, expected: 2, operator: "strictEqual" }).message); console.log(typeof assert.strict); }
